content.comment_body: If you set a decimal value in an analog threshold block, will that decimal show up on the operator interface? I’ve defined a connection to the Ax value of that block in the variable mapping. Thank you.

No. Specifying decimal places only affects how values are shown on the [product_name] or operator device display. The actual value sent to the operator interface is an integer, since [product_name] only handles integer values. To show decimals in the operator interface, you need to set the decimal places within its input/output field configuration.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are asking whether decimal precision from an analog threshold block in [product_name] automatically appears on the operator interface. The main point is that decimal formatting in [product_name] or its local display does not carry over by default; only integer values are transferred to the operator interface. To show decimal precision, manual configuration is needed in the operator interface display settings.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that decimal precision set within [product_name] will automatically be reflected on the operator interface without extra setup.
